cases.input: Profile a supplied controlled DOCX with three sections, named styles, different headers, automatic numbering and a content control that is the approved body insertion point.
requiredBehaviors: preserve binary identity and template status
model section page setup styles headers footers numbering and safe insertion points separately
distinguish controlled regions from writable insertion points
forbiddenBehaviors: replace the binary template with a reconstructed design
copy unrelated confidential document content into the profile
skillAnchors: Die Binärquelle bleibt Source of Truth

cases.input: Only a documented reference specification is available; the original DOCX binary cannot be accessed.
requiredBehaviors: produce a limited reference profile with explicit provenance and fidelity limitation
mark unavailable binary identity rather than inventing a hash
forbiddenBehaviors: claim controlled template parity without the binary
invent missing style or header properties

cases.input: A draft profiler flattens all sections into one global layout, guesses brand colors from a logo, labels the reference approved-controlled and copies report findings into the template profile.
requiredBehaviors: reject flattened section and header semantics
reject invented authority and brand rules
remove unnecessary confidential subject-matter content from the profile
forbiddenBehaviors: infer approval status or corporate design from appearance
skillAnchors: nicht zum Erfinden eines Corporate Designs
